decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.
Reason: In order to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended by Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: Unnumbered location plan, QMD.01, QMD.02, QMD.03, QMD.04. Received: 15/08/2025. HMO Management Plan, Planning Fire Safety Strategy. Received: 21/08/2025.
Reason: In order to ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.

Condition : 3 - Secure covered cycle parking facilities (for not less than 10 bicycles) for the occupants of, and visitors to, the development shall be installed in the rear garden. The approved facilities shall conform to the current Westtrans West London Cycle Parking Guidance (or such other guidance as shall supersede it) in design and layout and be fully implemented and made available for use before the first occupation of the development or commencement of the approved use as appropriate and thereafter retained for use at all times without obstruction. 
Reason: In order to support sustainable transport objectives.

Condition : 4 - The refuse and recycling store shall be completed and made available for use before the development hereby permitted is first occupied or brought into use following the requirements set in the West London Waste Plan and the Council's Recycling and Refuse guidance, and thereafter shall be retained for such use at all times without obstruction. The developer shall provide a set of containers adequate for the House in Multiple Occupation use for the storage and collection of recyclable materials for the purposes of the Council's kerbside recycling service, to the specification by the local authority's recycling collection service.  The waste and recyclable materials containers shall be stored in a proprietary refuse bin designed for the purpose to be supplied by the developer and located within the premises. Besides, the development shall also supply a garden waste composting bin following the aforementioned policies and guidelines.

Reason: In order to ensure adequate provision for waste and recycling.

Condition : 5 - The development hereby approved shall be occupied by no more than eight (8) persons at any one time.
Reason: In order to protect neighbours' living conditions and the character of the area.

Condition : 6 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the approved HMO Management Plan.
Reason: In order to protect neighbours' living conditions and the character of the area.
description: Retrospective application for a House in Multiple Occupation with a reduction in the number of persons accommodated from ten to eight.
